2608.08650.title: The Evolution of Mixture-of-Experts Architectures in Large Language Models: Routing, Topology, Load Balancing, and Expert Parallelism
2608.08650.paper_summary: Mixture-of-Experts models increase parameter capacity while keeping the computation activated by each token bounded, but their architectural evolution cannot be explained by a chronological list of model releases alone. This technical survey synthesizes primary papers, official technical reports, and prior surveys to organize modern Mixture-of-Experts systems along five coupled dimensions: expert granularity, expert topology, routing freedom, the scope of load balancing, and execution structure. We describe eight architectural milestones as a dependency graph with six mainline developments and two orthogonal branches, rather than as eight successive generations. We then analyze individual systems through four control planes: Expert Topology, Routing, Balance, and Expert Parallelism. These planes specify which experts exist, which experts process each token, how aggregate load is controlled, and how selected computation is mapped onto physical devices. The framework connects algorithmic choices such as Top-k routing, shared experts, fine-grained experts, and dynamic expert composition with systems concerns including token dispatch, device placement, all-to-all communication, and communication-computation overlap. We conclude with equal-budget pretraining experiments, quality and systems metrics, and open research questions. The main trend is a shift from merely activating more sparse parameters toward decoupling semantic routing, computational budgets, and physical execution.
2608.08650.paper_summary_zh: 混合專家模型在增加參數容量的同時，保持每個標記激活的計算量有限，但其架構演變不能僅通過模型發布的時間順序來解釋。這份技術調查綜合了主要論文、官方技術報告和先前的調查，以五個相互關聯的維度組織現代混合專家系統：專家粒度、專家拓撲、路由自由度、負載平衡範圍和執行結構。我們將八個架構里程碑描述為一個依賴圖，包含六個主要發展和兩個正交分支，而不是八個連續的世代。然後，我們通過四個控制平面分析各個系統：專家拓撲、路由、平衡和專家並行性。這些平面指定了哪些專家存在、哪些專家處理每個標記、如何控制總負載以及如何將選定的計算映射到物理設備上。該框架將算法選擇（如Top-k路由、共享專家、細粒度專家和動態專家組合）與系統問題（包括標記調度、設備放置、全到全通信和通信-計算重疊）聯繫起來。我們以相等預算的預訓練實驗、質量和系統指標以及開放研究問題作結。主要趨勢是從僅僅啟用更多稀疏參數轉向解耦語義路由、計算預算和物理執行。
2608.08650.author: Jiguo Li et.al.
